review_text: I have often stayed at Ciputra Hotel due to its strategic location, nearby mall, good service, delicious food, sufficient facilities, and the ability to get a room with a beautiful view of the city of Jakarta at night.
comfortable hotel, friendly staff, okay facilities, good food, if you want to go to the mall just step out of the lobby you can enjoy coffee leisurely
The quality of service, facilities, and other aspects are good, although it is old, it is still well-maintained. The location is very strategic.

Overall, I had a good stay at Hotel Ciputra. Customer service sent me a note of welcome  by whatsapp,  and asked if everything was in order or if I needed anything. That's really good as not many hotels do that. Although the room furnishings are a bit worn, the bed was very comfortable, and the place was clean. Being connected to the mall was also a big plus! It is also close to Central Park Mall 1 and 2, and Taman Anggrek, so you will not be spoilt for choice. when it comes to shopping. Another plus is it's much closer to the airport, so you can avoid the traffic jams in town. Would consider staying there again.
It's my return stay with this hotel. And still not make me regrets at all. Best value access and experience

The hotel is quite comfortable, connected to a mall, with clean rooms and quite complete facilities. However, the staff is lacking. When we were going to the mall and leaving our luggage in the storage area, because we were also checking out, there was often no staff waiting, and those who came would throw things at each other. It was very unprofessional and unfriendly.

I would go for the location and helpful staff only. Otherwise the hotel is old. Our phone did not work, the plumbing in the bathroom is very old and doesn’t work. The hotel needs a big upgrade in terms on infrastructure. It is located right next to the mall with a separate entrance for it - that is the most positive thing about the hotel. Definitely give the spa a pass. No hot water in the spa, the massage itself was strictly ok, not great. I was made to wait ima. Room with zero response from staff regarding when I could expect the masseuse. Better facilities available in the mall at lesser prices.

Stayed at Hotel Ciputra Jakarta multiple times, and it’s always my go-to when I’m in Jakarta. The location is super convenient, directly connected to the mall — great for food and quick errands. Rooms are comfortable and clean, though slightly dated. Service is consistently good, with friendly and efficient staff. Overall, a reliable and value-for-money hotel that I’ll keep coming back to.

It was my first staycation ever, and staying at Ciputra was a pleasant.  Check in & check out was smooth.  All staff were nice, even the housekeeper greeted me on the hall way.  Old building yes, but well-maintained. Room was clean, as well as the swimming pool.  For breakfast, there were plenty of options. But taste wise, honestly not the best. Just okay.  Overall, i’ll give 9/10 Definitely will come back!!

Stayed here 4 nights and paid about 767 AED total, which is actually very good value for Jakarta. The main reason I chose this hotel was its direct connection to Mal Ciputra Jakarta, which turned out to be extremely convenient.  👍 What Was Good Staff effort The staff were genuinely helpful and polite. When problems happened with the room, they assisted with luggage and helped move me twice without much resistance. They also later tried to make up for the experience by offering an executive dinner at the lounge on the 17th floor, which I appreciated.  Gym Surprisingly good for a hotel gym. It’s well equipped and spacious, easily one of the better hotel gyms I’ve seen.  Breakfast buffet Breakfast was solid with good variety. No complaints there.  Location & mall access This is honestly 75% of the reason to book this hotel. Being directly connected to the mall is extremely convenient for food, shopping and avoiding Jakarta traffic.  ⚠️ Where Things Went Wrong Room issues and multiple changes I had to change rooms twice. •	First time was around 2 AM after arrival because the shower wasn’t working and the bathroom felt quite dilapidated. •	The next morning I had to move again because the AC wouldn’t go below 23°C, which made the room uncomfortable.  The third room they gave me was more modern and functional, although slightly smaller. At least the bathroom and AC worked properly.  Food quality: This was probably the biggest disappointment.  One evening in the lobby I ordered chicken spring rolls and whiskey, and unfortunately bit into a bone inside the spring roll, which was not a pleasant experience at all. The staff removed the dish from the bill and offered a fruit plate, but it still left a bad impression.  The à la carte food was also underwhelming. I ordered a pepperoni pizza and fries for around 354,530 IDR, and the pizza honestly tasted like a frozen pizza that had been microwaved rather than freshly cooked.  Room service was similarly average.  🚧 Facilities The swimming pool was under construction, so I didn’t get to try it.  Final Thoughts Overall I’d say 3 to 3.5 stars.  The location, gym, and staff effort were good, but the room issues and disappointing food quality brought the experience down.  Would I stay again? Possibly for the location and mall access, but I would definitely skip ordering food at the hotel next time.

Business · Solo Rooms: 5/5  Service: 5/5 |  Location: 4/5 Everything about my stay here was good  From the moment I arrived, I was accommodated on a non-smoking floor. They upgraded my room  My room was wonderful, quiet, clean, and packed with great amenities. The bed was incredibly comfortable, the bathroom was very nice, and the fantastic view. It truly felt like a luxury retreat. The location is incredibly convenient, especially for  travelers.   The hotel is directly connected to a mall, making shopping and dining effortless. Supermarkets, malls, and plenty of food and drink options are just a few meters away.    It’s incredibly walkable with easy access to the train and bus stations.    I felt completely secure throughout my stay thanks to their 24-hour security service. If you are looking for comfort, luxury, and ultimate convenience, this is the place to stay. I have stayed a lot of times at this hotel with my family. As it is directly connected to a shopping mall it is easy for my family members to look for food and shop lightly. The room is quite spacious and clean, it does seem to be newly renovated so it is brightly lit and quite cosy. The view is nice overlooking Jakarta’s busy traffic.  Breakfast option is very limited and food often ran out when I was there but it is expected as there is always a crowd. Airport transfer is available at the concierge and able to book before hand to ensure smooth journey.  During my last stay, however the one experience that put us off was the waiting for room during check in was not communicated properly causing us to wait until 4pm at the hotel lobby for the room. We were told the room would be ready in 30 mins but it turned out the aircon was not working and required repair, but staff did not inform us causing us to wait for a long time. We were tired from the long journey and would appreciate the heads up. However when we checked with staff a few times, we were only to be told the room was being prepared. This was one experience though, the rest of the stay was good.
